name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage found in the 48h to 17 Nov; Microsoft explained its 12–13 Nov outage
state: Microsoft said on 16 Nov that its lengthy 12–13 Nov email and Intune outage was caused by a software defect introduced in a July fix (The Register). Searches found no multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage in the 48 hours to 05:40 UTC on 17 Nov; a SEGA Japan outage on 15 Nov was limited to one company. Normal holds.
for_you: No widespread service disruption is current. Provider status pages give the quickest confirmation if a service stops working.
rubric_hit: No major multi-hour outage in the past 48h = Normal
why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
